item.tib: khod spungs dran pa tshe yi sgrub pa'i skong ba rin chen gter spungs
item.coloph: ces tshe sgrab skong ba nor bu'i 'phreng ba 'di/ rig 'dzin gong ma'i bka' lung zab mo yi/ tshod yod rab chod ang tshod ma lags te/ sgrub gshen rtse gcig bsgrub pa'i dad mos kyis/ rnal 'byor dad ldan phywa g.yang bsgrub pa dang / gang zag gzhan don mdzad pa'i gshen grogs dang / raMng zhal gzhan rnams kyi nyams chags bskang ba'i phyir du/ 'di yin med pa'i th+wa la khi khar wer zhi'i bsnyen bsgrab skabs la/ dben gnas bkod legs ri khrod du sbyar ba'o/ 'gal 'khrul mchis na lha srung gnyen la bshags/ dge bas 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
